dataset.provenance: Zeyu Zhu (2026), reanalysis of Nishi et al. network public-goods experiment. CSV retains anonymized nodes, not participant demographics or survey weights.

outcome: whether the actor cooperated in an observed round 2–10, given a recorded own choice in the preceding round
unit: one node/round transition, with equal weight per session when comparing predictive risk
selection: lowest development session-mean Brier, tie in registered order; fit calibration groups only
evaluation: session-mean Brier vs constant, secondary log loss, calibration-in-the-large and per-session counts. Percentile bootstrap of the 16 held-out session-level loss differences.
missing: retain count of all node/round rows; current or preceding missing action cannot become a defection
